title: Page 2
content_zh:
望着杜天海那脸同情又摇头的表情，佟映晨不难猜测他此时的想法，于是又得花费更多力量去克制心中起伏的情绪，安慰自己能忍则忍，千万不能在这时候得罪他……千万不行……
“你是没有，但如果你跟我结了婚，就可以省去三天两头被父母催婚的困扰，不必再被逼着去参加那些你毫无兴趣的相亲宴。”她沉住气，尽量以平静的口吻向这个嚣张外加白目的男人解释自己之所以会这么提议的原因。
“你调查我？”杜天海浓眉轻挑，语调微扬，倏然意识到她这次造访原来并非冲动行事，而是有备而来。
“是做了点功课。”她更正他的说法，却不否认自己确实私下找人对他的背景作了一番了解，试图找出有可能说服他放弃对公司提告求偿的方法。
而照她所搜集到的资料看来，目前杜天海可能会有需要，而她又能拿得出来的抵押品就只有“婚姻”而已。
“既然做了功课，那么你应该也很清楚我有多少身价，若是娶了你，我怕我亏的就不只是这区区的六千万而已。”他双手交迭于脑后，直言这提议对他来说可不是笔划算的交易。光是以两人悬殊的财力来看，她嫁给他就像挖到一座钻石矿山一样，可是她对他却未必有这六千万的价值，还可能造成往后更多损失。
况且她如果真的去打听过，就该知道他杜天海除了不缺钱以外，最不缺的就是女人了，所以即使她长得颇具姿色，似乎也有点脑袋，但比她条件好的女人还是大有人在。他若真要娶妻，不愁找不到“挡箭牌”，何必先白白损失这一笔钱。
“关于这一点，请你大可放心，我会在婚前白纸黑字写明绝不会从你那里拿走任何一点不属于我的财产，也不会在婚后干涉你任何事情，只要你撤销告诉，连同积欠贵集团的本金、利息，将来我都会如数奉还，不会让你有所损失。”她清楚表达自己的立场，要他不必担心她会贪图他的财产，只希望他给她更多时间还清这笔欠款。
“你要还我钱？”他还以为她之所以开口向他“求婚”，就是为了不用还钱呢！
“我刚才已经说了，我的婚姻是用来抵押，不是抵债。”这两者是有差别的。
“意思就是你以后还会把它赎回去？”他笑问，开始觉得这女人有点意思了。
“没错，等我把钱还清，我们就离婚，到时候你也有足够的理由去说服你的父母，说你根本是个不适合婚姻的男人，请他们不要再逼你结婚。”这方法两全其美，对他们双方都有好处。
“那要是你永远都还不清这笔钱呢？”见她说得信誓旦旦，杜天海不禁要想这个女人在调查他之余，有没有顺便弄清楚自家公司的财务状况有多么吃紧，就算扣掉“龙腾”这笔求偿，也还有大笔的债务等着她去伤脑筋，而她却不惜押上自己的婚姻，坚持让这家摇摇欲坠的公司起死回生。
老实说，他欣赏她的自信，但又不得不怀疑她是否高估了自己的能力。
“在我把钱还清之前，你随时可以跟我提出离婚的要求，那并不会影响我的还款意愿。”她以为他是在担心她会故意欠他一辈子，霸占杜家二少奶奶的位置不放，所以当下就跟他保证他随时都可以退出这段婚姻，而她能提出离婚的唯一条件则是得还清这笔欠债。
“这么听来，好像变成你有些吃亏了，怎么办呢……我这个人也不太喜欢占女人的便宜。”他撑着下巴，皱起眉，一脸替她委屈的苦恼表情。
然而那表情看在她眼里却充满吊人胃口的嫌疑，让她觉得碍眼。
“在商言商，请杜先生不必投入太多私人感情和原则，只要告诉我你是否愿意接受这项抵押品就行了。”她以谈生意的口吻劝他不必多虑，速下决定，因为这将会影响到她全盘的还款计划。
“这个嘛……毕竟结婚是人生大事，我又没什么经验，最好还是先回去问一下我爸妈的意见比较好。而且你可别以为他们听到我说要结婚就会欣然同意，其实他们对我的结婚对象可是挺挑剔的，尤其是我妈。”他突然从浪子变成孝子，摆出一副对父母唯唯诺诺的态度，表示自己的婚事还得听从父母的意见……
白目！这鬼话荒谬到连鬼都不会相信！你没经验，难道我就有吗？！

“好，那么就请你尽快和父母亲讨论一下此事，希望早日得到你的答复，不打扰了。”佟映晨在心中大骂，努力维持住脸上的笑容，起身告辞，免得忍不住翻了他那桌拼图，当场拆穿他的睁眼说瞎话。
据她手上的数据和实际观察看来，他明明就是个叛逆、我行我素兼目中无人的家伙，跟“乖宝宝”形象完全沾不上边！
不过，既然他一副不想当场给答案的样子，她想自己再留下来和他耗时间也是无用，还是先回去处理其它债务问题吧。
“你对多少人提出过这样的抵押条件？”在她临出门前，他突然有此一问。
她停下步伐，愣了两秒，回头告诉他——
“只有你。怎么了吗？”
“只是好奇。你慢走，不送了。”他扬起一抹潇洒的笑，起身走向自己的办公桌，开始研究刚才没看完的公文。
她走出他的办公室，对这男人的印象又添一条——
莫名其妙！
第1章(2)
☆☆☆ 言情小说独家制作 ☆☆☆
半个月后，杜天海主动约佟映晨见面，而且约人的方式嚣张得很，只发了通简讯告知她该出现的时间、地点，逾时不候。
“你好像一点也不意外我会约你？”车开了一段路，他看她的神情始终持平，没什么起伏，清亮的双眼亦如透明玻璃般不见任何情绪变化。
“我一直在等你给我答复。”她原本就在等他的电话，不明白何来意外之有。
倒是对于他换下西装后的这身打扮——微乱的黑发、宽松的衣着，加上一双玩世不恭的眼神……
随兴的风格在这男人身上成了一股狂放、不受拘束的气质，让他像是一头褪下文明的野兽，增加不少危险的气息，连脖子上的银色项链都拴不住他所散发的野性。
如果他不是“龙腾”的副总裁，不是她的头号债主，佟映晨直觉自己根本不该上这种男人的车，还是和他保持点距离比较好。
“哦，是这样啊，我还以为是因为你昨天在画廊遇到我妈，还顺便请她和她的朋友们吃了一顿饭，聊了一下午的缘故呢！”他轻哼了声，似笑非笑地望着身旁的女人，眸中闪过一丝戏谑。
“那不会只是个巧合吧，佟小姐？”他意有所指地问她，很想知道这个一板一眼的女人听到他的话后会作何反应，怎么回答。
昨天杜母在逛画廊的时候，“巧遇”了一位自称与她小儿子相识不久的女性友人，双方在一顿午餐中相谈甚欢，回家后杜母就频频追问儿子那名女子跟他究竟是什么关系，进展到哪个阶段，未来有没有什么打算……

杜天海的耳朵被轰炸了一整晚，今天当然要约她出来把两人的关系弄清楚了。
“我想如果伯母讨厌我的话，那我也不必再等你的答复了。”她简单明了地回答，毫无畏惧地迎向他的目光，表情不见半点心虚与惊慌，也没否认遇到杜母是她刻意的安排。
content_en:
Looking at Du Tianhai's expression of sympathy and shaking his head, it was not difficult for Tong Yingchen to guess what he was thinking at this time, so he had to spend more effort to control the ups and downs of emotions in his heart, comforting himself that he could bear it as long as he could, and must not offend him at this time... No way...
"You don't, but if you marry me, you can save yourself the trouble of being urged to get married by your parents every three days, and no longer have to be forced to attend those blind dates that you have no interest in." She calmed down and tried to explain to this arrogant and white-eyed man in a calm tone the reason for her proposal.
"Are you investigating me?" Du Tianhai raised his thick eyebrows slightly and raised his tone slightly. He suddenly realized that her visit this time was not impulsive, but rather well-prepared.
"I did some homework." She corrected him, but did not deny that she had indeed found someone in private to learn about his background, trying to find a way to possibly persuade him to give up the lawsuit against the company.
According to the information she collected, Du Tianhai might be in need now, and the only collateral she could offer was "marriage".
"Now that you have done your homework, you should also know very well how much I am worth. If I marry you, I'm afraid I will lose more than just this mere 60 million." He folded his hands behind his head and said frankly that this proposal was not a good deal for him. Judging from the disparity in financial resources between the two, her marriage to him would be like digging into a diamond mine, but she may not be worth the 60 million to him, and it may also cause more losses in the future.
Besides, if she had really inquired, she would have known that Du Tianhai, apart from money, the most important thing he lacked was women, so even though she was pretty and seemed to have some brains, there were still many women with better conditions than her. If he really wants to marry a wife, he won't have to worry about finding a "shield", so why lose this money in vain first.
"Regarding this, please rest assured. I will state in black and white before the marriage that I will never take any property from you that does not belong to me, nor will I interfere with anything after the marriage. As long as you revoke the notice, I will repay the principal and interest owed to your group in full in the future without causing you any loss." She expressed her position clearly, asking him not to worry that she would covet his property, and she only hoped that he would give her more time to pay off the debt.
"You want to pay me back?" He thought that the reason why she "proposed" to him was so that she didn't have to pay back the money!
"As I said just now, my marriage is used as a mortgage, not to pay off debts." There is a difference between the two.
"Does this mean you will redeem it in the future?" He asked with a smile, beginning to think this woman was a bit interesting.
"That's right, when I pay off the money, we will divorce. At that time, you will have enough reasons to convince your parents that you are not a man suitable for marriage at all, and ask them not to force you to get married again." This method has the best of both worlds and is beneficial to both of them.
"Then what if you can never repay the money?" Seeing her swearing, Du Tianhai couldn't help but wonder if this woman had found out how tight her company's financial situation was while investigating him. Even if Longteng's claim was deducted, there was still a large amount of debt waiting for her to worry about, but she did not hesitate to put her marriage on the line and insisted on bringing this shaky company back to life.
To be honest, he admired her confidence, but he had to wonder if she overestimated her abilities.
"Before I pay back the money, you can ask me for divorce at any time. It will not affect my willingness to repay." She thought he was worried that she would deliberately owe him a lifetime and occupy the position of the Du family's second mistress, so she immediately assured him that he could withdraw from the marriage at any time, and the only condition for her to file for divorce was to pay off the debt.
"It sounds like it's becomeYou're at a disadvantage, what should you do...I don't really like taking advantage of women. He held his chin up and frowned, with a distressed expression on his face that felt aggrieved for her.
However, the expression in her eyes was full of appetizing suspicion, which made her feel an eyesore.
"In terms of business, Mr. Du, please don't invest too much personal feelings and principles, just tell me whether you are willing to accept this collateral. "She persuaded him in a business-like tone not to worry too much and to make a decision quickly, because it would affect her overall repayment plan.
"Well... after all, getting married is a major event in life, and I don't have much experience. It would be better to go back and ask my parents for their opinions first. And don’t think that they will readily agree when they hear that I want to get married. In fact, they are quite picky about who I marry, especially my mother. "He suddenly changed from a prodigal son to a dutiful son, and assumed a submissive attitude toward his parents, saying that he had to obey his parents' opinions on his marriage...
White eyes! This nonsense is so ridiculous that even ghosts won’t believe it! You have no experience, do I have it? !
"Okay, then please discuss this matter with your parents as soon as possible. I hope to get your answer as soon as possible. I won't interrupt you. "Tong Yingchen cursed in his heart, trying hard to maintain the smile on his face, and stood up to leave, lest he couldn't help but turn over his puzzle table and expose his lies on the spot.
According to the data in her hands and actual observations, he is clearly a rebellious, independent-minded and arrogant guy, and has nothing to do with the image of a "good baby"!
However, since he looked like he didn't want to give an answer on the spot, she thought it was useless to stay and spend time with him, so she should go back to deal with other debt issues first.
“How many people have you made such a mortgage offer to? "Before she left the house, he suddenly asked.
She stopped and was stunned for two seconds, then turned around and told him——
"Only you. What's wrong? "
"Just curious. You walk slowly and don’t send me off. " He raised a chic smile, stood up, walked to his desk, and began to study the official document that he had not finished reading just now.
She walked out of his office, adding another impression to this man——
Inexplicable!
Chapter 1(2)
☆☆☆ Exclusive production of romance novels ☆☆☆
Half a month later, Du Tianhai took the initiative to ask Tong Yingchen to meet, and the way he made the appointment was very arrogant. He only sent her a text message telling her the time and place to show up, and he would not wait after the time limit.
"You don't seem to be surprised at all that I would ask you out? "The car drove for a while, and he saw that her expression remained calm, with no ups and downs, and her clear eyes were as clear as transparent glass, showing no emotional changes.
“I’ve been waiting for your answer. "She had been waiting for his call and didn't understand why it was unexpected.
But what he looked like after changing out of his suit—slightly messy black hair, loose clothes, and a pair of cynical eyes...
The casual style has become a wild and unrestrained temperament in this man, making him like a beast that has faded from civilization, adding a lot of dangerous atmosphere. Even the silver necklace around his neck can't restrain the wildness he exudes.
If he was not the vice president of "Long Teng" and her number one creditor, Tong Yingchen intuitively felt that she should not get into this man's car at all, and it would be better to keep a distance from him.
"Oh, that's right. I thought it was because you met my mother at the gallery yesterday and treated her and her friends to a meal and chatted all afternoon! "He snorted softly and looked at the woman beside him with a half-smile, a hint of teasing flashing in his eyes.
"Isn't that just a coincidence, Miss Tong? " He asked her meaningfully, wanting to know how this serious woman would react and how she would answer after hearing his words.
Yesterday, when Du's mother was browsing the gallery, she "accidentally met" a female friend who claimed to have known her youngest son for a short time. The two had a lunchThey had a great conversation during the meal. After returning home, Du's mother frequently asked her son what the relationship between that woman and him was, what stage it was in, and whether he had any plans for the future...
Du Tianhai's ears had been bombarded all night, so of course he wanted to ask her out today to clarify the relationship between the two.
"I think if Auntie hates me, then I don't have to wait for your answer any longer." She answered simply and clearly, meeting his gaze without fear, with no trace of guilt or panic on her expression, nor did she deny that meeting Du Mu was a deliberate arrangement on her part.
